Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/james-stephens/mary-mary

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- James Stephens, the author, died 1950 (Wikidata Q508101). Citizenship: Ireland.

First publication of the text used: 1912 (SE colophon: 'Mary, Mary was published in 1912 by James Stephens.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: works published before 1931 are in the public domain in the United States. The colophon dates this work to 1912. The edition's rights statement (quoted below) says the same.
- Country of origin (not stated by the colophon): the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life plus 70 years or less for this death, so the text is public domain in each of them by 1 January 1 January 2021. The last person to die among the people whose words are in the text is James Stephens, in 1950.
